notes_for_editor: Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association list names this tower. Searches of the association, DNR and news pages found no build, height, builder, removal or site-condition source for Lake Julia. WXPR, DNR and WJFW supply statewide context only and do not mention this tower. Staffing, access and visit facts are left out. Worth asking the Forest County Historical Society or the Lakewood/Laona ranger district.
